ranked.headline: Statistical models target error sources in single-cell and spatial RNA-seq data
ranked.summary: Finer spatial, annotation, and cell-type-resolved scales now expose specific error sources in RNA-seq that statistical methods must address.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict binding, interactions and design from sequence and graph data
ranked.summary: New benchmarks and multimodal architectures now test molecular predictors at scale across proteins, RNA, DNA and small molecules.

ranked.headline: Docking and AlphaFold 3 benchmarks on PROTAC, antibody, and protein-protein complexes
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of docking and structure models for PROTAC ternary and antibody complexes now test physics and ML scoring side by side.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking gene network and expression inference methods against simple baselines
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether network and expression inference methods beat simple baselines, alongside new tools for scalability and benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict regulatory and expression effects of genomic variants
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence encoders and variant-aware architectures are now being applied to non-coding variant effects on regulation and gene expression.

ranked.headline: Gapless and long-read human genome references with benchmarked variant calling
ranked.summary: Reference genomes and benchmarked variant calls now reach near-complete, gapless quality across populations and ONT long-read data.

ranked.headline: Graph structures paired with external priors for transcriptomic inference across omics
ranked.summary: Preprints from November 2025 apply graph neural networks, graphical lasso, and optimal transport to spatial and single-cell RNA-seq inference problems.

ranked.headline: Proteome-wide prediction of protein interactions, functions, and disordered grammars
ranked.summary: Deep learning and AlphaFold-based screens are now applied across entire human proteomes, moving beyond single-protein prediction to systematic inference.

ranked.headline: Compact Indexes and Interfaces Make Genomic Data Analysis More Tractable
ranked.summary: Long-read methylation and k-mer indexing tools now report large storage and memory gains, alongside accessible single-cell analysis environments.

ranked.headline: Genomic resources dissect domestication, hybridization and methylation inheritance
ranked.summary: Population-scale pear genomes, a cross-species spruce SNP array and phased grapevine methylomes extend genomic inference across woody species.

ranked.headline: Machine learning predicts carbapenemase production and simulates AMR evolution in genomes
ranked.summary: ML resistance prediction is moving onto phenotypic inputs like disk diffusion zones and onto simulated resistance evolution across bacterial genomes.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and AlphaFold2 models predict immune peptide and antibody recognition
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair structure-based and learned predictors of peptide-MHC, antibody pairing and epitope immunogenicity with experimental…

ranked.headline: GPU and SIMD acceleration of sequence alignment and metagenomic read simulation
ranked.summary: Recent tools accelerate alignment and simulation on GPUs and SIMD while packaging analysis stages as composable command-line components.

ranked.headline: Learned representations map biomolecular conformational dynamics from MD and AFM data
ranked.summary: Learned and ensemble-level models now connect MD trajectories, AFM images, and kinetic analysis to biomolecular conformational dynamics.

ranked.headline: Protein language model, structure, and chemical embeddings fused into shared learned…
ranked.summary: Sequence, structure, and chemical embeddings are being aligned in shared spaces to support zero-shot prediction and protein function prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Learned pocket prediction coupled to docking removes need for prespecified site
ranked.summary: Learned pocket prediction and graph networks are being paired with docking and physics-based workflows for binding and permeability prediction.

ranked.headline: Single-cell measurements constrain time-resolved models of gene expression and signaling
ranked.summary: Minute-scale single-cell sampling now resolves NF-κB response bifurcation and feeds dynamic models of cellular behavior.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve allosteric rewiring, lipid scrambling and coarse-grained sampling
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling and coarse-grained simulations now resolve variant-specific allosteric networks, lipid scrambling and conformational changes in protein…

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models prioritize targets via network dynamics and kinase-substrate maps
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether explicit network, dynamical, and proteomic structure can rank candidate biological targets.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked computational pipelines for mass spectrometry and multiplexed imaging data
ranked.summary: Standardized, benchmarked, and consensus-based processing is being applied at successive steps of MS and imaging data analysis.

ranked.headline: Learned tokenizers for protein structure and genome sequence language models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints replace fixed biological units with learned discrete tokens and address long-context inference in DNA language models.

ranked.headline: Network models infer metabolic regulation from spatial, single-cell and multi-omic data
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics and multi-omic atlases now enable metabolic regulatory circuits to be inferred as network structure.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale mining of bacterial secreted peptides with leader and structure inference
ranked.summary: Population-scale genomes now enable systematic discovery of bacteriocins and antimicrobial peptides with explicit leader-peptide and structure inference.

ranked.headline: Alignment-free and compressed methods are scaling microbial genomic analysis
ranked.summary: Alignment-free, compressed, and marker-guided software now targets dN/dS, phylogeny, read classification, and taxonomic assignment in microbial data.

ranked.headline: Curated Inputs and Diverse Data Drive Data-Efficient Pathology and Omics Modelling
ranked.summary: Pathology and omics models increasingly trade patch volume and dense annotation for curated inputs and uncertainty-aware, data-efficient training.

ranked.headline: Reducing redundant sequencing files to cut genomics storage costs
ranked.summary: SeqManager flags duplicate and intermediate sequencing files to reduce genomics storage costs, reporting fast runtime.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools couple mechanistic modeling with machine learning and data sharing
ranked.summary: Recent releases address model specification, hybrid modelling, LLM-based access to SBML models, and reproducible ML workflows.

ranked.headline: Curated records and learned models drive biomedical compound and asset ranking
ranked.summary: Learned models over curated bioassay, trial, and chromatographic data are being built to prioritize compounds and therapeutic assets.

ranked.headline: Reference-free diversity from ultraconserved loci; benchmarking tick genome assemblies
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark public tick assemblies and estimate diversity from ultraconserved loci, alongside a new sugar beet long-read reference.

ranked.headline: Topology-preserving and personalized encodings of brain networks and imaging dynamics
ranked.summary: Longitudinal MRI/PET, dynamic functional connectivity, and weighted brain networks now admit individual-level and topology-aware graph modeling and testing.

ranked.headline: Noise, feedback and regulatory architecture shape transitions between cell states
ranked.summary: Recent preprints quantify state-dependent noise, expression drift on lineage trees, and Boolean ensemble dynamics to model cell state transitions.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained MD of antibody and TCR CDR loops informs loop-conditioned sequence design
ranked.summary: Ensemble-scale CDR loop dynamics are now being coupled to conformation-conditioned generative design of antibody sequences.

ranked.headline: Causal metrics and graph models for inferring regulatory and disease networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address how to evaluate and apply causal structure inferred from gene regulatory and longitudinal blood-test networks.

ranked.headline: Geometry and transport set aging, oscillation and assembly dynamics in simulations
ranked.summary: Geometry and transport are increasingly treated as explicit control parameters across condensates, membranes and multicellular assemblies.

ranked.headline: Measured tissue structure and strain inform constitutive models of heart, skin, and gels
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple imaging-derived structure and strain fields directly to constitutive parameter inference in cardiac, skin, and collagen tissue models.

ranked.headline: Differentiable and recurrent models link learning rules to neural circuit dynamics
ranked.summary: Gradient-based training now reaches detailed biophysical neurons and recurrent models of conditioning and working-memory learning.

ranked.headline: Convergent gene loss and recombination suppression shape lineage-level genome evolution
ranked.summary: Recent comparative analyses across 154 animal and 94 mammal species link gene content shifts and recombination suppression to evolutionary outcomes.

ranked.headline: Computational annotation links plant protein features to seed and developmental traits
ranked.summary: Deep learning and contrastive models now generate testable genome-scale predictions in maize and legumes, with CRISPR tests in maize.

ranked.headline: Computational methods link single-cell perturbations and splicing to functional readouts
ranked.summary: Single-cell and morphological profiling at scale now support statistical tests of genetic convergence and splice-level immunotherapy associations.

ranked.headline: Metagenomic recovery resolves gut, soil, and ocean microbial genetic diversity
ranked.summary: Large metagenomic and metatranscriptomic datasets now resolve strain-level, plasmid, and sexual-reproduction features across habitats.
